Why Choose IV Therapy Over Oral Supplements?

The difference between a daily vitamin and an IV drip is not just price; it is biology.

When you take oral supplements with water, the nutrients must pass through your digestive system where stomach acids break them down. This typically results in an absorption rate of only 20 percent. IV therapy provides a massive clinical advantage by delivering pharmaceutical-grade nutrients directly into your bloodstream. This ensures 100% absorption and immediate cellular uptake, so you feel the benefits instantly.

Oral Supplements (Pills/Water)

Absorption 20%

Must pass through the digestive system, where acids break down nutrients.

IV Therapy (Irving Health & Wellness)

Absorption 100%

Delivered directly into the bloodstream for immediate cellular uptake.

The Clinical Science Inside Your Drip

We use only high-quality, pharmaceutical-grade nutrients. There are no unnecessary fillers or preservatives, just pure wellness designed to target your specific biological functions.

Glutathione

Known as the master antioxidant, it binds to toxins in the liver to eliminate them, reducing oxidative stress and brightening your skin complexion.

B-Complex & B12

Essential for converting food into energy, we use highly bioavailable forms to combat brain fog and afternoon crashes.

Zinc & Vitamin C

A powerhouse combination for your immunity. Zinc slows viral replication while Vitamin C fuels white blood cell production to fight off infection.

Magnesium

Nature's relaxant is critical for reducing migraines, lowering anxiety, and preventing muscle cramps common in the Texas heat.

Our Uncompromising Medical Standards

When you choose our clinic, you benefit from elite safety protocols:

Hospital-Grade Sterility

A strictly controlled clinical environment significantly reduces infection risks compared to mobile IV vans or in home treatments.

Medical Expertise

You receive care with immediate access to licensed medical professionals and emergency equipment if it is ever needed.

Zero Hidden Fees

We believe in honest care with absolutely no travel fees or surprise upcharges, providing transparent pricing you can trust.

PATIENT EXPERIENCE

You should bring:
